_meta.notes: Amendment to the June 17 interim: 'Yes' checked with date of report '8/28/14', signed 9/3/14, received SEP 03 2014; the Summary Page's own 'Date of Report' box reads 'August 28, 2014'. Every Summary figure is IDENTICAL to the original June filing (key b128e943) — the amendment evidently corrected the itemized schedules, not the totals.

itemized.itemized_pages_B: 6 (attachment listing only - see notes, there is NO Schedule B form page in this PDF)

contributions.detail: exact (41952.53 = 41952.53) against Summary Page line 1 Column A AND the attachment's own printed 'TOTAL: $41,952.53'. 77 rows = 76 named/entity rows + one '22 donors at $50 or less' aggregate line of 910.00. Three rows are marked in-kind by the sheet's own column and all three are required for the total to close.

expenditures.detail: exact (17278.12 = 17278.12) against Summary Page line 2 Column A AND the expense sheet's own double-ruled total 17,278.12. 61 rows.

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: NO 'SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE' figure is filled anywhere in this filing - p3's SUBTOTAL and TOTAL cells are both left blank ('See attached' is written in the first row) and there is no Schedule B form page at all. The gates that DO exist are the attachments' own totals: contributions p4+p5 rows = 41,952.53 = the sheet's printed 'TOTAL:' - PASSED; expenditures p6 rows = 17,278.12 = the sheet's printed double-ruled total - PASSED. Both also equal the Summary Page Column A lines. Every gate available on this filing closed to the cent.
itemized.escalation_note: no disputed cells. The two contribution sheets were read from the 250 dpi rotated full pages and the expense sheet in four overlapping 400 dpi band crops (the page is 61 rows deep, so a single 200 dpi full-page read would have put each row at ~18 px). The first pass of those bands was cropped too far right and lost the Date column entirely - the crop was redone at x=300 to bring the dates back rather than inferring any date. Both sides then closed exactly, so no cell needed resolution beyond that.
itemized.notes: PAGE ORDER: 1 cover, 2 Summary Page, 3 'Itemized Contributions Received' form (blank grid, 'See attached' in row 1, SUBTOTAL and TOTAL cells BLANK), 4-5 LANDSCAPE contributions attachment, 6 PORTRAIT expenditures attachment. THERE IS NO 'Itemized Expenditures Made' FORM PAGE IN THIS PDF - the expenditure side exists only as the attachment. That is a real property of the document, not a missing render; all 6 pages were rendered and classified. Pages 4-5 are landscape and were rotated 90 deg CLOCKWISE (PIL rotate(-90)) to read; their geometry is converted back to the portrait page as poppler renders it, so each contribution row is a NARROW VERTICAL band. Page 6 is portrait and needs no rotation. PRIVACY: the county redacted only the STREET column; the attachment prints City and State in separate columns, so donor_city/donor_state ARE populated here (the one filing in this chunk where they are). Zip codes are printed on the page and were deliberately not recorded. THE FILING IS AN AMENDMENT and says so on its own face: the cover ticks 'Yes, this is an amendment' dated 5/28/14, the attachment headers read 'Contributions AMENDED', and the sheet's footnote states '*This report was amended to correct the donor of the $6000 donation on 6/16/14 (highlighted above)' - that row (contribution line 75, McAdams for Salt Lake County Mayor) is highlighted in yellow on the page and is transcribed as the CORRECTED donor. Note the cover checks the INTERIM 'June 17' box while the form's masthead reads '2014 Financial Disclosure Report ... [County Officeholders - Year-End]' - the checked box is the report type. The expense sheet's amount column is headed 'Total' and its category column 'Category'. Cover: Jennifer Wilson, Democrat, Office Sought 'Salt Lake County Council At-Large A'; signed 9/3/14, stamped RECEIVED SEP 03 2014 - i.e. an amendment to the June interim filed in September.
